checks.description: core/ never imports a domain module
checks.fix: invert the dependency: the module imports core (or core defines a port the module implements)

checks.description: A controller/router never imports a repository
checks.fix: call the service; only the service talks to the repository

checks.description: A module never imports another module's repository
checks.fix: use the other module's exported service, or move the shared query to core

checks.description: A feature never imports another feature's repository
checks.fix: use the other feature's service, or move the shared query to core

checks.description: Only the config module reads the environment
checks.fix: add the variable to the env schema and inject the typed settings
